modules.title: Introduction to Apejuwe (Adjectives and Adverbs)
modules.html:
Words used to describe nouns and verbs in Yoruba. This section covers introduction to apejuwe (adjectives and adverbs).

Key points

  • Study the meaning, main features and examples of apejuwe (adjectives and adverbs).
  • Be able to explain apejuwe (adjectives and adverbs) in your own words and give examples.
  • Practise the 50-question quiz for this topic until you score well without notes.

Worked examples

Q: Báwo ni a ṣe ń kọ 'emi' pẹ̀lú àmì ohùn tí ó tọ́ bí ó bá dúró fún 'breath of life'?
A: Ẹ̀mí — The word for soul or spirit is written as 'Ẹ̀mí' with a low tone on 'Ẹ' and a high tone on 'i'.

Q: Kí ni iṣẹ́ fáwẹ́lì nínú ọ̀rọ̀ Yorùbá?
A: Wọ́n ń gbé ohùn jáde — Vowels are the nucleus of syllables in Yoruba; every syllable must contain a vowel to carry a tone.

Kí ni iṣẹ́ fáwẹ́lì nínú ọ̀rọ̀ Yorùbá?

quiz.q: Báwo ni a ṣe ń kọ 'emi' pẹ̀lú àmì ohùn tí ó tọ́ bí ó bá dúró fún 'breath of life'?
quiz.solution: The word for soul or spirit is written as 'Ẹ̀mí' with a low tone on 'Ẹ' and a high tone on 'i'.

quiz.q: Kí ni iṣẹ́ fáwẹ́lì nínú ọ̀rọ̀ Yorùbá?
quiz.solution: Vowels are the nucleus of syllables in Yoruba; every syllable must contain a vowel to carry a tone.

quiz.q: Báwo ni a ṣe ń pè 'Pronoun' ní èdè Yorùbá?
quiz.solution: The word for Pronoun is Ọ̀rọ̀-asojú-orúkọ (a word that stands in for a name).

quiz.q: Mélòó ni fáwẹ́lì inú èdè Yorùbá lápapọ̀?
quiz.solution: Standard Yoruba has 12-13 vowels depending on dialect counting: 7 oral (a, e, ẹ, i, o, ọ, u) and 5 nasal (an, ẹn, in, ọn, un).

quiz.q: Kí ni Yorùbá ń pè ní 'Naming Ceremony'?
quiz.solution: Ìsọmọlórúkọ is the naming ceremony usually performed on the 8th or 9th day.

quiz.q: Kí ni Yorùbá ń pè ní 'Destiny'?
quiz.solution: Destiny is known as 'Àyànmọ́' or 'Àpín-orí'.

quiz.q: Kí ni iṣẹ́ 'Èmi' nínú èdè?
quiz.solution: 'Èmi' expresses the first person identity.

quiz.q: Kí ni ìtumọ̀ 'Ẹ kú àárọ̀'?
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Good morning.

quiz.q: Iye lẹ́tà nínú áábídì Yorùbá:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Mẹ́ẹ̀ẹ́dọ́gbọ̀n (25).

quiz.q: Ìwé ìtàn àròsọ ni:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Ògbójú Ọdẹ.

quiz.q: Ìsọmọlórúkọ wà fún:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Sísọ ọmọ lórúkọ.

quiz.q: Kí ni 'Come'?
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Wá.

quiz.q: Kí ni a ń pè ní Ìsọ̀gbé (Elision)?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Yíyọ fáwẹ́lì kan kúrò.

quiz.q: Kí ni iṣẹ́ Ọ̀rúnmìlà?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Ifá dídá/Imọ̀.

quiz.q: Kí ni a ń pè ní 'Fọ́nẹ́tíìkì'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Ìmọ̀ ìpèró.

quiz.q: Níbo ni a ti máa ń ra nǹkan?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Ọjà.

quiz.q: Kí ni 'Oríkì'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Praise Poetry.

quiz.q: Kọ́ńsónáǹtì mélòó ni ó wà nínú álífábẹ́ẹ̀tì Yorùbá?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: méjìdínlógún.

quiz.q: Àṣà wo ni Yorùbá ń ṣe láti fi kí ẹni tó bímọ tuntun?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Ẹ kú ewu ọmọ.

quiz.q: Ta ni a kà sí 'Baba' eré oníṣẹ́ Yorùbá?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Hubert Ogunde.

quiz.q: Èwo ni 'White' ní Yorùbá?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Funfun.

quiz.q: Kí ni à ń pe 'Adjective'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Ọ̀rọ̀-Àpèjúwe.

quiz.q: Àwọn lẹ́tà tí a kò ni 'h' níbẹ̀rẹ̀ ni:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Fáwẹ̀lì.

quiz.q: Aṣọ òkè jẹ́ aṣọ:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Ìbílẹ̀.

quiz.q: A ń lo 'Ẹ' bẹ̀rẹ̀ ọ̀rọ̀ fún:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Àgbà (Ọ̀wọ̀).

A ń lo 'Ẹ' bẹ̀rẹ̀ ọ̀rọ̀ fún: — Àgbà (Ọ̀wọ̀).
Kí ni orúkọ baba Ṣàngó — Ọ̀ráńyàn.
quiz.solution: A ń lo 'Ẹ' bẹ̀rẹ̀ ọ̀rọ̀ fún: — Àgbà (Ọ̀wọ̀).

Iru aṣọ wo ni àwọn Yorùbá máa ń wọ̀ fún ayẹyẹ pàtàkì — Aṣọ Òkè.
